action.objective: Verify Bxd7, the reserved exact-score candidate, at full depth for commits.
action.rationale: Broad search gave b5d7 exact 391 as top root; Black cannot immediately recapture since queen is on d7 and own rook on a8, so Bxd7 wins the queen for a bishop. Single-candidate verification at depth 4 with the full reserved allowance confirms no Black tactical refutation before committing.
